arguments.subject: Re: why am I being logged out every time I switch machines?
arguments.body:
Hi Maya,

I'm really sorry for the disruption and frustration this has caused you, especially on a deadline. I can confirm that signing in on multiple devices with the same Google SSO account should not sign you out of your other devices—this is not an intended policy change or expected behavior.

Your saved payment or billing method does not affect your sign-in sessions on other machines. This sounds like a possible bug or a change in how sign-in state is managed across devices, but the support documentation does not describe the situation you're experiencing.

For a full investigation, this will need a human support engineer to check your account's sign-in logs and session state. Please keep this message as your ticket receipt—I'm escalating your case right now and you should get a direct response from a human support engineer as quickly as possible (Pro plan targets <24h, but urgent cases are prioritized).

Thank you for your patience, and again, I'm sorry your workflow has been interrupted. If you have anything else for the human support engineer to know—such as the OS version, any recent changes in your environment, or whether you've tried clearing cookies—please reply to this thread with the details.

Best regards,
Lyra Support Bot

arguments.subject: TCK-4827 - Escalation: Customer being logged out across machines
arguments.body:
Internal escalation note:

Customer Maya Reyes (Pro plan, maya.reyes@reyes-design.co) reports that since a few days ago, signing in on any of her three regular devices is signing her out (silently, no warning) on whichever device she last used. This is a change from prior behavior and has already resulted in WIP being lost twice in her agent threads. SSO account, no device/billing change, started a few days ago, urgent and deadline today. No public documentation covers this behavior.

Please investigate account/session logs. Customer expects an urgent response (is threatening to cancel). Lyra replied as first responder and informed her of this escalation.

arguments.subject: Re: Invoice PDF won't download
arguments.body:
Hi Daniel,

I'm sorry you're having trouble downloading your March invoice PDF. While the support articles don't list an ongoing issue with invoice downloads, here are a few quick things to try:

1. Clear your browser cache and try the download again.
2. Make sure any pop-up blockers or privacy extensions are temporarily disabled when clicking the download button.
3. Try downloading from a private/incognito browser window, as stale cookies or extensions can sometimes affect downloads.
4. If your bank enforces extra verification, make sure you allow cookies for billing.cursor.com.

If you are still unable to download the invoice after trying these steps, please reply here and I can escalate your case to a human support engineer to provide the invoice directly and look into any backend issues.

Thanks for reaching out, and let me know if this resolves it or if you need help!

Best,
Lyra Support Bot

arguments.subject: Re: Feature request: keyboard shortcut for inline edit
arguments.body:
Hi Riya,

Thank you for your suggestion! Currently, there isn't a dedicated keyboard shortcut for triggering inline edit mode directly—cmd-K, followed by clicking, is the standard workflow at the moment. Your request for a direct shortcut has been noted and I've forwarded it as a feature request to the product team.

If a shortcut is added in a future update, it will be announced in the release notes and support documentation. If you have any other suggestions or workflow needs, feel free to share them!

Best regards,
Lyra Support Bot
